_about: Exact authored Surf and rod species, in native slot order. The water generator copies these species into existing wild_encounters.json method tables and preserves their levels and encounter rates. Region/cap describe authoring context, not physical access or evolution readiness. Land and Rock Smash are authored directly in wild_encounters.json.

MAP_ROUTE103.why: Shore birds and tide-pool residents occupy the early channel; the land Corphish and Wingull are available before the later Surf and fishing methods.

MAP_ROUTE102.why: Keep every improved land slot including Timburr 11% and Pachirisu 8%; upgrade the Super Rod Lombre slot to Ludicolo 20%.

MAP_PETALBURG_CITY.why: Replace marine pond inhabitants with native freshwater families. Old Rod Magikarp/Marill stays unchanged; later rods progress from small pond fish to evolved freshwater partners.

MAP_ROUTE104.why: Briney's beach. Wingull country, Wiglett burrows in the sand, Skrelp hides in the kelp off Petalburg Woods.

MAP_DEWFORD_TOWN.why: Keep Old Rod Mantyke unchanged; the Good Rod now leads with Qwilfish and follows with Chinchou/Staryu. Neighboring Route 106 supplies Old Rod Remoraid.

MAP_ROUTE106.why: Barbaracle replaces Super Rod Luvdisc 30%; Shuckle replaces Rock Smash Woobat 10%; Old Rod Remoraid 40% supports Dewford Mantyke. Receive Pidove in repeated Wingull 10% grass, retaining all Fighting options and earlier Route 103 Wingull.

MAP_ROUTE105.why: Mantine replaces the leading Super Rod Luvdisc 30%. Receive Ledyba 10% from Route 104 in repeated Wingull's palm-shore foliage slot, retaining Crabrawler, Inkay, Chatot and Cramorant; Wingull now has earlier Route 103 grass and plentiful coastal Surf homes.

MAP_ROUTE107.why: Floatzel replaces Surf Kingler 18%. Arrokuda joins Old Rod 40%; Good Rod follows Floatzel/Arrokuda/Barraskewda, and Barraskewda leads Super Rod 30% with Floatzel as a smaller return. This deliberately develops the fast-swimmer population.

MAP_ROUTE108.why: Receive Lapras from ship B 1F in the outside Surf Mantine 18% slot; Mantine retains other coasts. Replace Super Rod Luvdisc 20% with Jellicent. Keep Dhelmise limited at Surf 10% and preserve other wreck-associated residents.

MAP_ROUTE109.why: Upgrade Super Rod Shellder 20% to Cloyster. Keep all beach-rock Sandygast/Pincurchin encounters and other methods unchanged.

MAP_SLATEPORT_CITY.why: Clawitzer30%/Dragalge25% replace the generic Super Rod lead pair, developing Old Rod Clauncher and Good Rod Skrelp. Preserve Dhelmise10% offshore and all earlier methods.

MAP_ROUTE110.why: Receive Blitzle 13%/Yamper 8% in repeated Electrike/Pachirisu slots; Electrike 103 and Pachirisu 102 remain earlier. Receive Patrat 6% from 123 and Watchog 5% from 120; Stunky goes to 121 and Morpeko to 115. Tadbulb moves from land 5% to Old Rod 60%, retaining its pre-Wattson timing; Chinchou stays Old Rod 40%. Meowth receives freed land 5% from 117. Preserve Plusle/Minun, all pollution residents and Roaming Gimmighoul. Lanturn leads stronger fishing and Clawitzer replaces late Luvdisc.

MAP_ROUTE111.why: Keep the desert land roster intact. Replace Super Rod Octillery 30% with Whiscash and its old 10% Whiscash slot with Gastrodon.

MAP_ROUTE114.why: Floatzel replaces Super Rod Seaking 30%, retaining Dratini. Receive Komala from 118 in repeated Nuzleaf 11% cliffside tree grass; Seedot remains 102 and Nuzleaf evolves from it, while the other established cliff residents stay.

MAP_ROUTE115.why: Rustboro's north shore. Rocky shallows: Krabby, Binacle, Shellder; a Mantyke in the surf on a good day.

MAP_ROUTE117.why: Day Care ponds. Gentle water: Lotad, Marill, Ducklett; Tympole singing in the reeds.

MAP_ROUTE118.why: Where the river meets the sea. Carvanha come upstream; the Good Rod is found here and the water proves it.

MAP_ROUTE119.why: Rainforest river. Feebas water; Tympole and Poliwag everywhere, Slowpoke asleep on the bank.

MAP_ROUTE120.why: Reed marsh: Wooper, Masquerain and Chewtle. Ludicolo is the distinctive Super Rod find among the freshwater residents.

MAP_ROUTE121.why: Mt. Pyre foreshore: Frillish and Swanna over still water, with Jellicent on the Super Rod.

MAP_ROUTE123.why: Berry Master's river. Fat, healthy fish: Goldeen, Corphish, Basculin; Buizel racing the current.

MAP_ROUTE122.why: Replace Super Rod Kingler 20%/Shellder 15% with Jellicent/Basculegion. Keep Surf Frillish and Super Rod Dhelmise 10% around Mt. Pyre.

MAP_LILYCOVE_CITY.why: Milotic and Alomomola replace repeated Kingler/Shellder in advanced bay fishing; preserve Wailmer/Cramorant Surf and the full shore Rock Smash table.

MAP_ROUTE124.why: Huntail and Gorebyss lead advanced shell-bed fishing; leave Mantine/Clamperl Surf and the separate rated10 Dive map intact.

MAP_ROUTE125.why: Walrein and Dewgong replace Luvdisc/Corsola on Super Rod; retain both Qwilfish forms, the kelp resident Dragalge and the full existing cold-water Surf roster.

MAP_ROUTE126.why: Alomomola/Bruxish/Aqua Tauros lead the crater-ring Super Rod, with Dragalge and Feebas retained; Surf Aqua Tauros and all Dive placements remain unchanged.

MAP_ROUTE127.why: Toxapex/Dragalge replace Super Rod Kingler/Shellder; preserve Mareanie/Pyukumuku/Bruxish Surf and Old Rod Bruxish.

MAP_ROUTE128.why: Good Rod now centers Sharpedo/Dragalge/Barraskewda; Super Rod receives Jellicent in its repeated Wailord slot, developing predatory cavern-approach fishing.

MAP_MOSSDEEP_CITY.why: Swap Starmie and Wailord between30% and10% Super Rod slots; retain accessible25% Surf Staryu.

MAP_EVER_GRANDE_CITY.why: Finished Kingdra/Lapras/Gyarados lead the League approach fishing, followed by Mantine and Cloyster; all earlier methods remain unchanged.

MAP_ROUTE129.why: Wailord/Lapras/Mantine replace the generic leading Super Rod trio; preserve the existing Wailmer/Wailord pods on Surf.

MAP_ROUTE130.why: Preserve the complete Wynaut land colony. Bruxish/Starmie take the two leading Super Rod slots; one Hisuian Qwilfish slot remains20%, beside Relicanth and Basculegion.

MAP_ROUTE131.why: Archaeological fishing is led by Relicanth and Omastar with Huntail/Gorebyss and rare Basculegion. Omastar supplies a mature aquatic fossil and distinguishes this pool from Route134; Clamperl stays in Surf/Good Rod.

MAP_PACIFIDLOG_TOWN.why: Replace15% Super Rod Shellder with Gorebyss; preserve Alomomola, fishing birds, and all other methods.

MAP_ROUTE132.why: Gyarados replaces Surf Magikarp; Barraskewda/Sharpedo/Floatzel lead the stronger rod to match the fast currents. Old Rod Magikarp/Arrokuda stay.

MAP_ROUTE133.why: Lanturn leads return fishing; Walrein/Dragalge replace Clamperl/Luvdisc, connecting the existing cold-water and kelp Surf populations.

MAP_ROUTE134.why: Huntail/Gorebyss/Relicanth take75% of Super Rod; Clawitzer and Kingdra are useful deeper companions, distinct from Route131 aquatic fossils. Existing easier-method Clamperl stays.

MAP_SOOTOPOLIS_CITY.why: Milotic/Gyarados/Alomomola take the three main Super Rod positions, with Wishiwashi/Finizen forming the sheltered crater school. Leave every other method and the separate Dive habitat unchanged.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ENTRANCE.why: Replace Surf Magikarp12% with Lanturn; preserve Old Rod Magikarp/Chinchou, Surf Sharpedo, and the existing evolved fish in rods.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM6.why: Barbaracle35%, Gligar16% and Golisopod16% define the shore with other walkers. Keep Frillish/Jellicent and Dragalge in Surf; receive Barraskewda12% and Sharpedo10% there. Kingdra is55% of Super Rod, followed by Dragalge20%, Barraskewda15% and Basculegion10%; Clawitzer remains on Entrance Good Rod and neighboring sea rods.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM7.why: Toxapex39% and Barbaracle21% replace Mawile and swimming fish, supported by Golisopod/Malamar/Grapploct/Crobat. Preserve the entire Clamperl/Huntail/Gorebyss Surf pool and replace Good Rod Luvdisc with Clamperl.

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_ENTRANCE_ROOM.why: Swap Spheal/Zubat to let Spheal lead. Relocate entrance Surf Snom/Cetoddle into duplicate Swinub/Cubchoo land slots, preserving arrival-area availability; those displaced juveniles remain in earlier Seaspray and deeper Shoal. Surf receives Sealeo/Lapras and Super Rod Cetoddle becomes Lapras. Rated10 Ice stays unchanged.

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_INNER_ROOM.why: Replace Surf Cetoddle with Walrein35% and indoor Wailord with Dewgong18%; Clamperl25%, Jellicent12% and Lapras10% remain. Cold cave Super Rod becomes Lanturn30%, Relicanth25%, Cloyster20%, Hisuian Qwilfish15% and Dewgong10%, removing Cetoddle and the generic Luvdisc/Shellder mix. Preserve Galarian Darumaka and every land resident; Snom/Cetoddle retain entrance land access and the untouched Ice roster. Wailord, Octillery, Luvdisc and Shellder remain available globally.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_1F_1R.why: Keep all land encounters and the Old Rod unchanged. Floatzel joins Buizel/Whiscash Surf; the Good Rod develops Buizel/Whiscash alongside Crawdaunt, and the Super Rod features Floatzel/Whiscash with Crawdaunt, Drednaw and the existing Dratini slot.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_1F_2R.why: Keep the entire land roster, including Scream Tail/Ferrothorn, and keep Surf/Old Rod unchanged. Add Lapras to the Good Rod; lead the Super Rod with Milotic/Lapras and retain Seismitoad and Feebas in their native smaller slots.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_B1F_1R.why: Keep the dragon Surf population and all land/earlier rods unchanged. The Super Rod becomes Dragonair 45%, Kingdra 35%, Dratini 20%; ordinary river/sea predators retain other regional encounters.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_B1F_2R.why: Keep every land discovery, especially Roaring Moon/Salamence/Dragonite. Only replace Super Rod Golduck/Lombre with Kingdra/Milotic, preserving the other slots and all earlier methods.

MAP_PETALBURG_WOODS_3.why: Exeggcute 13% replaces Oddish in actual foliage; Oddish receives orchard grass 6%. Keep Bellsprout, Kartana, Croagunk, Murkrow, Goomy, Phantump, Misdreavus and Emolga early. The pond's later rod now develops freshwater residents instead of Lanturn/Octillery.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_NORTHWEST.why: Preserve every land resident. Floatzel/Dragonair replace Super Rod Golduck/Lombre; Dratini remains on Surf and Super Rod.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTHEAST.why: Safari lowland stream: Marill, Lotad and Goldeen families, with Azumarill as the Super Rod prize.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTHWEST.why: Safari deep pond. Slowpoke banks, Psyduck, Carvanha that shouldn't be this far inland.

MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS.why: Only replace the cistern Swanna slot with Relicanth at 12%, following the report’s preferred ancient-pool interpretation. Preserve Great Tusk, Unown, the entire relic land roster and all rods/Rock Smash.

MAP_SCORCHED_SLAB_B1F.why: Replace Noibat/Gurdurr/Machoke with Torkoal/Magmar/Heatmor, creating 13%/20%/16% volcanic residents. Surf and rods establish a Slowbro/Gastrodon hot pool, replacing the exact Route102 Super Rod copy; retain Old Rod, Surf Feebas and Super Rod Dratini. Gurdurr and Machoke become evolution-only, with Timburr on Route102 and Machop in Rusturf preserving their earliest family access.

MAP_SEASPRAY_CAVE.why: Replace Surf Wailord 12% with Lanturn. The rods develop Chinchou/Relicanth and sheltered rock-pool shellfish instead of generic beach filler; retain all land Tynamo and both Stunfisk forms unchanged.

MAP_ABANDONED_SHIP_HIDDEN_FLOOR_CORRIDOR.why: Flooded wreck: Frillish and Jellicent haunt the corridors; Dhelmise is the leading Super Rod catch and a Surf discovery.

MAP_ABANDONED_SHIP_ROOMS_B1F.why: Replace indoor Lapras with Barbaracle in the hull; the early-area owner receives Lapras in Route108 outside water. Preserve the rated10 flooded corridors.

MAP_ALTERING_CAVE_B1F.why: Guzzlord retains its exact 8% slot, surrounded by Druddigon 23%, Spiritomb 18% and Malamar 17%. Basculegion/Jellicent define the pond and stronger rods, with Malamar tying the methods together. Lucario remains in the adjacent 1F wing; Blissey and Eelektross retain their original basement slots. Rock Smash, Old Rod and hidden tables are unchanged.

MAP_VICTORY_ROAD_B2F.why: Dragapult 30%, Baxcalibur 25% and Volcarona 16% replace repeated modest/middle-stage land slots. Keep Noivern, Kommo-o, Metagross and Iron Valiant; upgrade only Surf Shellos/Dratini to Gastrodon/Dragonair and Super Rod Golduck to Milotic, preserving earlier access and the other water slots.
